### 1. Introduction & Project Plan
* **Website Title:** CodeLab Hub
* **Mission Statement:** To bridge theoretical computer science concepts and practical coding application by providing accessible, interactive self-assessments, virtual coding simulations, and peer discussion forums.
* **Objectives:**
  1. Develop a role-based ASP.NET Web Forms platform for registered and guest learners.
  2. Provide interactive digital learning objects, including HTML5 video labs and automated self-assessment quizzes.
  3. Enable administrators to perform full CRUD operations on courses, quizzes, and user accounts.
* **Project Scope:** Non-registered guests can browse the catalog and preview introductory multimedia tutorials. Registered members can enroll in virtual labs, take graded self-assessments, track progress, and post in asynchronous Q&A forums. Administrators manage all learning resources and user privileges.
* **Project Schedule:** Weeks 1–3: Proposal & Requirement Gathering; Weeks 4–6: UI Storyboarding & Database ERD Design; Weeks 7–11: Core ASP.NET & SQL Server Implementation; Weeks 12–14: Validation Testing & Documentation.

### 2. Requirement Specification & Storyboard
* **Audience Modelling:** Target users are computing undergraduates (aged 18–24) requiring mobile-responsive layouts, intuitive navigation, and instant quiz grading.
* **Use Cases & Major Functions:**
  * *Guest:* View Home, Search Catalog, Register Account.
  * *Member:* Login, Attempt Self-Assessment Quiz, Post in Asynchronous Forum, Update Profile.
  * *Admin:* Login, Add/Edit/Delete Learning Resources, Moderate Forum, Manage Users.
* **Authentication & Quiz Process Flow:** User requests `/Member/SelfAssessment.aspx` -> Server checks `Session["UserRole"]` -> If null, redirect to `Login.aspx` -> If valid, load questions dynamically from `Quizzes` table -> User submits answers -> Server calculates score, inserts record into `AttemptHistory`, and renders feedback.

### 3. Design and Modeling
* **Entity Relationship Diagram (ERD):**
  * `Users` (**PK** `UserID`, `FullName`, `Email`, `PasswordHash`, `Role`, `CreatedAt`)
  * `LearningResources` (**PK** `ResourceID`, `Title`, `Category`, `VideoUrl`, `SimulationHtml`, `Difficulty`)
  * `Quizzes` (**PK** `QuizID`, **FK** `ResourceID`, `QuestionText`, `OptionA`, `OptionB`, `OptionC`, `CorrectOption`)
  * `QuizAttempts` (**PK** `AttemptID`, **FK** `UserID`, **FK** `ResourceID`, `Score`, `AttemptDate`)
  * `ForumPosts` (**PK** `PostID`, **FK** `UserID`, **FK** `ResourceID`, `PostContent`, `PostedOn`)
  * *Relationships:* One `LearningResource` has many `Quizzes` (1:M) and many `ForumPosts` (1:M). One `User` records many `QuizAttempts` (1:M).
* **Wireframes & Storyboard:** All pages inherit `Site.Master`, featuring a top semantic `<header>` and sticky `<nav>` bar with dynamic links based on login state, a 12-column responsive `<main>` content container, and a consistent `<footer>`.
* **Website Navigational Structure:** Hierarchical tree architecture anchored by `Default.aspx`, branching into Public Catalog (`Catalog.aspx`), Authentication (`Login.aspx`, `Register.aspx`), Member Portal (`Dashboard.aspx`, `SelfAssessment.aspx`, `Forum.aspx`), and Admin Control Panel (`ManageResources.aspx`, `ManageUsers.aspx`).

### 4. Implementation & Discussion
* **Cascading Style Sheets (CSS):** A three-tier styling strategy was implemented. External CSS (`site.css`) controls typography, color palette (`#0056b3` primary, `#f9fbfd` surface), and Flexbox grid responsiveness. Internal `<style>` blocks customize page-specific components like quiz cards, while inline styles highlight urgent system alerts.
* **Form Validation:** Dual-layer validation protects data integrity. Client- and server-side ASP.NET validators (`RequiredFieldValidator`, `RegularExpressionValidator`, and `CompareValidator`) prevent empty inputs and malformed emails prior to database execution.
* **Database Connectivity (ADO.NET):** All database interactions use `SqlConnection` and parameterized `SqlCommand` queries to prevent SQL injection. `SqlDataAdapter` and `DataTable` bind dynamic records to `GridView` and `Repeater` controls for seamless client/server synchronization.

### 5. User Guidance
* **Home & Catalog Page:** Displays interactive cards with HTML5 `<video>` previews and category filters.
* **Member Self-Assessment Module:** Authenticated learners select radio buttons for multiple-choice questions and click "Submit Quiz" to receive instant automated grading and store their score.
* **Administrator Dashboard:** Provides an interactive `GridView` with inline Edit/Delete buttons and a modal form to insert new virtual lab resources.

### 6. Conclusions, Formatting & References
* **Summary & Reflection:** CodeLab Hub successfully fulfills all functional and database requirements. During development, our team initially faced viewstate conflicts when dynamically binding quiz questions inside an `UpdatePanel`; resolving this taught us how the ASP.NET page lifecycle interacts with postback events. Future enhancements will include WebSockets (SignalR) for real-time synchronous peer coding.
* **Formatting Note:** Prepared in accordance with APU Level 2 standards (Times New Roman 12pt, 1.5 line spacing, justified alignment).
* **References:**
  * MacDonald, M. (2021). *Beginning ASP.NET 4.8 in C#*. Apress.
  * W3C. (2023). *HTML5 and CSS3 Web Standards Documentation*. Retrieved from https://www.w3.org/

### 7. Appendix: Week 7 Proposal Report
Includes the approved Week 7 Proposal detailing initial scope, target persona definitions, and preliminary milestone dates.
